scope: Read-only metadata audit. No assets inserted; Studio mode unchanged. 27 Creator Store searches (additional targeted searches requested by coordinator), current metadata retrieval and official documentation lookup.

license.basis: Roblox Creator Store documentation describes free-to-use audio for Roblox experiences. PSE/APM metadata confirms partner provenance. No permission for off-platform extraction/reuse inferred. Public availability alone was not treated as a guarantee for third-party/IP uploads.

findings: Stone: five short PSE variants identified; existing 2 plus 3 new metadata candidates.
Whoosh: current 3 PSE source recordings are correct and short; search returned irrelevant uploads, so current provenance is safer.
UI error currently uses a long 3.6-second metal hit stretched by pitch 0.7-0.75; replace with dedicated PSE electronic falling beep 9125540237, short shaped envelope.
Metadata duration and runtime duration may differ (e.g. metal_1 description 1.7 s versus runtime 1.255 s); runtime TimeLength is the operational measurement.
Pickup 93529351909119 credits Freesound LilMati, but no license link or terms are supplied. Do not assert the sample is licensed merely because it loads.
Coin 4608067546 explicitly requests attribution to aisleofplenty when used. Preserve attribution if retained.
APM stings names/metadata do not imply anime score: Early Bird Hit1 is quirky tropical; Through the Roof is sly organ. May not fit final sonic identity.
Search verifiedCreatorsOnly did not yield provenance assurance: IP rips and unknown uploads still appeared. Excluded from recommendation.

After extra targeted searches, all requested families have PSE candidates; a catalogue selection is not an audible quality approval. Exact crops/levels/loop seams need runtime and listening validation.

results.description:
the original sample was recorded by the freesound user Astounded (Wind_blowing_gusting_through_french_castle_tower.wav)
this loop doesn't work that well because the original recording really was never intended to be used for a more calmer sound like i had wanted (thus the segment i sampled being so short making the loop get repetitive)
i'd personally recommend using another loop or layering this with others but if you want to use this go ahead

special shout out to the many roblox games i've recognize this audio in like a sleeper agent, it's crazy how an asset i uploaded 6 years ago as of writing this is still used to this day, even though i'm not really that proud of the quality on the loop it's still pretty cool lol

i've seen fisch use it, nico's nextbots, and a couple of other games use this, but please take my advice and layer this with something else too!
